en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There are no omissions (allowed) in Al-Maghrib and Al-Fajr (Salāts)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
There is no confusion (acceptable) in al-Maghrib and morning Salah (prayer).”’
